name: nl-tax-agent-skills
description: Conversational, source-traceable Dutch tax workpacks for manual Mijn Belastingdienst entry.

interface.longDescription: Prepare source-traceable Dutch tax workpacks right in the conversation, in Claude Cowork, ChatGPT Work, Codex, or another Agent Skills host. The assistant reads the documents you share, asks only the missing questions, cites a reviewed source for each rule, maps each amount to its Mijn Belastingdienst field, and builds a manual-entry checklist when you ask. Nothing is saved unless you ask; then it keeps one workpack file per workflow that you can attach later to continue. It never logs in, files, signs, submits, or automates Mijn Belastingdienst.
defaultPrompt: Read my jaaropgaven and help me prepare my 2025 return.
